paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: God is love, and that's not a slogan, that's WHO HE IS. He showed it by sending His one and only Son so that we might live through Him (1 John 4:9). And look at the order. The writer says, "not that we loved God, but that He loved us" (1 John 4:10). Nobody earned it, and nobody had to go first.

So where does our love come from? "We love because He first loved us" (1 John 4:19). Our love isn't something we cook up from scratch in a bad mood at 6 a.m. It's a batch made from His recipe. And that's why the writer says the one who doesn't love doesn't know God (1 John 4:8), and why he calls the person who says "I love God" but hates his brother a liar (1 John 4:20). Loving the people you can see is how the love you can't see shows up.

Now here's the part I love most. "There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear" (1 John 4:18). Being loved like this means you can live without that knot in your stomach, friend, even about the day of judgment (1 John 4:17). So go on and love the people in front of you today. You don't have to earn a seat at God's table, because He's already loved you first.
